$Comment: What a Wild Turkey (the feast's own, Harvest_Feast_Turkey) drops: the game's turkey drops (Drop_Turkey: raw wild meat and a light hide, copied here whole because a role names one drop list), plus, very rarely, a Turkey Trophy to place at home. The last Choice is the rare roll: Weight 1 against Empty's 199 is a one-in-two-hundred chance per Wild Turkey. Raise the Empty weight to make it rarer. The game's own turkeys keep the game's list and never drop the trophy.
